# WEEKLY SCHEDULE — Apr 24–30, 2026
*Generated by trainer — April 24, 2026*
*Phase: Athletic Evolution Protocol — Level 1, Week 1 of Foundation*

---

## THEME THIS WEEK
**No impact. Correct pronation. Build the arch.**
Every session this week is low-load but high-intention. The goal is to wake up muscles that have been dormant and establish the neural connection between the brain and the foot. This is not optional — it is the foundation everything else sits on.

---

## DAILY NON-NEGOTIABLES (Every day, no exceptions)

| Task | When | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ☀️ 15 min barefoot on grass in sunlight | Morning | Face the sun. Barefoot on dirt/grass. T3/T4 + cortisol rhythm |
| 🦶 Big Toe Pull — 3 × 30 sec / foot | Morning | Pull toe into extension, ball of foot stays expanded |
| 🔄 Toe Retraction — 10 reps | Morning | Pull toes back without arch dropping |
| 🍚 Ziani Bounces — 2 min | After every meal | Low-amplitude toe raises. Insulin sensitivity + bone blood flow |
| 💤 8 hrs sleep, pitch-black room | Night | No phone in bed. This is when bone heals (GH pulse) |
